easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Faceless Butcher, and Phantom Steed must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Phantom Steed for its mana cost.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
